card.statement:
Let $\lambda\in \mathfrak{h}^*$ be dominant,
${\bf x} \in {\mathbb C}^r $ and $F$ be injective on $L(\lambda)$.
If $N\neq 0$ is a simple subquotient of $\mathcal D_{F}^{\bf x} L(\lambda)$ then

$$Ann_{U(\mathfrak{g})} L(\lambda)=Ann_{U(\mathfrak{g})} D_F^{\bf x}  L(\lambda)=Ann_{U(\mathfrak{g})} N .$$
card.label: Corollary 16

paper.title: Simple modules for Affine vertex algebras in the minimal nilpotent orbit
paper.abstract: We explicitly construct, in terms of Gelfand--Tsetlin tableaux, a new family of simple positive energy representations for the simple affine vertex algebra V_k(sl_{n+1}) in the minimal nilpotent orbit of sl_{n+1}. These representations are quotients of induced modules over the affine Kac-Moody algebra of sl_n+1 and include in particular all admissible simple highest weight modules and all simple modules induced from sl_2. Any such simple module in the minimal nilpotent orbit has bounded weight multiplicities.
